name: role_creation
description: Provision a new AI employee end-to-end — from raw role description to deployed team member. Clarifies the role's responsibilities with the user, researches the domain to produce a comprehensive responsibility document, decomposes the role into skills and tools, then deploys to a target team. Use when the user wants to hire, onboard, design, or stand up a new AI employee for any function.
example_requests: I want to build an AI customer support lead
onboard an AI data scientist for our analytics team
design a new AI role that handles release coordination

clarification.value: Follow your best judgment based on the role context.
